answer: Issuance is tied to graded-work history, so a new identity earns almost nothing until 12 epochs of honest answers are on record. Cloning 860 keys multiplies the waiting, not the payout, and any junk verdict resets the clock to zero. The karst is the check that cannot be faked, the basalt is the price the attacker pays, and the opal is the record that outlives the epoch.
